component.name: GridCraft
component.summary: Calculate, analyse and chart data in workbooks

description.p: This is a community package of GridCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the GridCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.
GridCraft is an open-source, native spreadsheet written in Rust that follows the Microsoft Excel workflow.

ul.li: Opens and saves .xlsx workbooks and CSV/TSV files
Formatting, sorting, filtering, pivot tables and charts
Every command can be driven by AI agents

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=gridcraft-cli ai.storyteller.gridcraft --help

Permissions: this package uses the same sandbox as upstream's own Flatpak manifest: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, and the Documents and Downloads folders. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.gridcraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, Open Recent): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.gridcraft
